text: Visitors have raised concerns about the timed ticketing system, with several noting frustration at being turned away without a reservation despite low crowd levels and requesting more flexibility. Signage and accessibility, particularly for handicap parking and transportation from the lot to the entrance, were also mentioned as needing improvement. Some reviews criticized the use of AI in exhibits, describing it as poorly executed and detracting from the experience. While many found the architecture and interactive exhibits engaging, there were comments about the high proportion of replicas on display. Staff interactions received mixed feedback, with some visitors perceiving a lack of accommodation or sympathy.

windows.7: Visitors in the past week have expressed frustration with the requirement for timed tickets, especially given the low crowd levels and the lack of flexibility when arriving without a reservation. Two critical reviews specifically noted feeling unwelcome and encountering unaccommodating staff when requesting exceptions. Some visitors also mentioned issues with the interactive exhibits and the use of AI elements, suggesting these aspects could be improved. There were occasional comments about crowding and interpretation, but these were less frequent. Overall, the main concern centers on access policies and staff responsiveness.
